name: Book of the Ancients
summary: At the Ethel Rethor tower, Azore Aldamort entrusts you with the Gem of the Serpent. Set it on the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle, northwest of the tower, and the guardian of the Book of the Ancients will appear.

sections.title: The Serpent Statue
sections.body: After Sceptre of Light, Azore Aldamort gives you the Gem of the Serpent. Ranazjar Isle lies northwest of the Ethel Rethor tower, and there the Serpent Statue waits. Set the gem on its hand to call forth the Book of the Ancients’ guardian. The naga have kept the book’s secrets for centuries, and Azore hopes it will teach much about their scaled foes.

aliases: who gives book of the ancients
faq.answer: Azore Aldamort keeps the tower at Ethel Rethor. Azore hopes to learn much about the naga, whom Azore calls scaled foes.

faq.q: What is the Book of the Ancients?
aliases: what is the book of the ancients
faq.answer: The Book of the Ancients holds secrets the naga have kept for centuries. Someone guards it.

aliases: where do i go with the gem
faq.answer: Ranazjar Isle is a small island northwest of the Ethel Rethor tower.

faq.q: What is the Gem of the Serpent for?
faq.answer: Set the Gem of the Serpent on the hand of the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle to bring forth the guardian of the Book of the Ancients.
Sceptre of Light comes before this step.
